```python
    sig  = hmac.new(b"k", body, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    raw  = body + sig
    return {"raw": raw, "hash": H(raw), "key": key, "amount": amount, "law": law}

def admit(tx):
    # pure function of tx alone -> uniform drops, no drift
    if not hmac.compare_digest(hmac.new(b"k", tx["raw"][:44], hashlib.sha256).digest(), tx["raw"][44:]): return False
    if tx["amount"] > MAX_TX: return False
    if tx["law"] != 1: return False
    return True
```

```python
def encode(st):
    out = bytearray(MAGIC_STATE)
    out += struct.pack("<IQ", st["law"], st["lamport"])
    keys = sorted(st["entries"])
    out += struct.pack("<I", len(keys))
    for k in keys:
        amts = sorted(st["entries"][k])
        out += k + struct.pack("<I", len(amts)) + b"".join(struct.pack("<Q", a) for a in amts)
    seen = sorted(st["seen"])
    out += struct.pack("<I", len(seen)) + b"".join(seen)
    return bytes(out)

def root(st): return H(encode(st))

def join(a, b):
    law = max(a["law"], b["law"]); lam = max(a["lamport"], b["lamport"])
    ent = {}
    for k in set(a["entries"]) | set(b["entries"]):
        ent[k] = sorted(a["entries"].get(k, []) + b["entries"].get(k, []))
    return {"law": law, "lamport": lam, "entries": ent, "seen": a["seen"] | b["seen"]}

def apply_tx(st, tx):
    if not admit(tx): return st
    if tx["hash"] in st["seen"]: return st
    st2 = join(st, {"law": tx["law"], "lamport": st["lamport"]+1,
                    "entries": {tx["key"]: [tx["amount"]]}, "seen": {tx["hash"]}})
    check_invariants(st2)
    return st2
```
